source_backbone: Kew POWO/WCVP 2026, IPNI, ITIS, Shaw & Wipff 2018, Wipff 2021
synonyms_under_accepted_species: Bouteloua trifida var. burkii (Scribn. ex S.Watson) Vasey [POWO citation; competing historical authorship]
Chondrosum trifidum var. burkii (Scribn. ex S.Watson) R.B.Shaw & Wipff
synonym_and_rank_caution: Chondrosum trifidum is an alternative homotypic genus combination, not a separate accepted species under POWO. The burkii rank and original variety authorship are source-dependent; preserve original source labels. Do not convert photos to variety-level voucher identifications.
native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; no native/county fields changed
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — individual specimen and photo IDs not independently established by taxonomic nomenclature
install_decision: Existing canonical B. trifida only; no species installation or canonical edits

decisions.subject: Bouteloua trifida Thurb. ex S.Watson
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted Poaceae species in Bouteloua; canonical authorship matches
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts B. trifida; IPNI gives Proc. Amer. Acad. Arts 18:177 (1883).

decisions.subject: Chondrosum trifidum (Thurb. ex S.Watson) Clayton
decisions.proposed_decision: Record as homotypic combination, not a distinct species
decisions.detail: POWO lists Chondrosum trifidum as the homotypic synonym; Clayton's combination published 1982.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua burkii Scribn. ex S.Watson
decisions.proposed_decision: Map as heterotypic synonym of B. trifida, retain historical source label
decisions.detail: Published 1883 and treated under accepted B. trifida; 2018 protologue-based combination cites this as basionym for Chondrosum var. burkii.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua trifida var. burkii (Scribn. ex S.Watson) Vasey
decisions.proposed_decision: Under POWO, synonym of species-level B. trifida, not an accepted additional learner variety
decisions.detail: POWO lists var. burkii as heterotypic synonym; exact older authorship/publication has separate UNRESOLVED note.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua trinii (E.Fourn.) Griffiths
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical combination to B. trifida
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP synonym list places B. trinii under accepted B. trifida.

decisions.subject: Chondrosum polystachyum E.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve as historical pro-synonym reference mapped to B. trifida concept
decisions.detail: POWO lists under B. trifida and marks pro syn.; do not claim separately validly published species.

decisions.subject: Chondrosum trifidum var. burkii (Scribn. ex S.Watson) R.B.Shaw & Wipff
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve 2018 published combination as synonym under POWO
decisions.detail: The 2018 publication proposes variety under an alternative generic treatment; Kew currently places it under accepted B. trifida.

decisions.subject: Chondrosum trinii E.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical synonym to B. trifida
decisions.detail: Recognized in POWO and ITIS synonym lists under B. trifida.

decisions.subject: Chondrosum virletii E.Fourn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map heterotypic historical synonym to B. trifida
decisions.detail: Listed by POWO and ITIS under the same accepted species.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua trifida protologue and type
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve full accepted author and source type metadata; no name correction needed
decisions.detail: IPNI lists E. Palmer 1355, Coahuila, as type collection and 1883 original publication; no type material examined in this run.

decisions.subject: Separate species cards for Chondrosum trifidum, Bouteloua burkii or var. burkii
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject automatic duplicate learner species/variety installation
decisions.detail: These historical names map to one currently accepted B. trifida species concept in POWO.

decisions.subject: Automatic replacement of Bouteloua trifida by Chondrosum trifidum
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject canonical rename based solely on a competing generic classification
decisions.detail: Current backbone accepts Bouteloua; an alternative Chondrosum circumscription does not justify changing existing canonical identity.

decisions.subject: Photographic and individual specimen identity
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain specimen/photo identification hold; name verification cannot validate a pictured specimen
decisions.detail: Canonical images include source-labelled and provisional observations; no individual specimen, type, or microscopic characters authenticated in this taxonomy-only run.

decisions.subject: Hybrid or introgression provenance
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not assert or negate hybrid ancestry for any photographed or historic specimen without individual evidence
decisions.detail: No taxon-specific hybrid ancestry evidence established in this name audit; existing scientific holds preserved.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua sensu lato versus Chondrosum generic concept
decisions.proposed_decision: Document competing generic circumscriptions without silently overwriting POWO backbone
decisions.detail: POWO accepts Bouteloua trifida but cites older Chondrosum alternative; Wipff 2021 advocates narrower Bouteloua and Chondrosum separation.

decisions.subject: Bouteloua trifida var. burkii early authorship and protologue details
decisions.proposed_decision: Require original 1894 and 1912 publications/IPNI reconciliation before choosing one definitive variety citation
decisions.detail: POWO prints (Scribn. ex S.Watson) Vasey in 1912; ITIS and Shaw & Wipff 2018 cite Vasey ex L.H.Dewey and an 1894 treatment. Species-level synonym mapping remains stable.

notes: Research-only evidence. Preserve existing species, image rights, range and all other workers' files.
